Is this literally exactly the same as WMIv12 or is there some tiny difference?

The latter, some things were changed inside the model. But the output is the same

If it stands for “chill drive” then it has earned the name.  Lat is just ok compared to SC model.  e2e long is weird. It feels smooth. But I have to give it gas a lot.  On the highway in NJ you have to go 20 above the speed limit to keep up with traffic. But this might do only 10 above and you’re getting passed constantly.  On winding local roads it will occasionally come to almost a complete stop (10mph) for a sharp curve.  

It felt like a cautious safe driver and it very well might be able to do a long highway drive with no disengagements.  But it feels like a longer drive because it’s driving at a slower speed, even with the “aggressive” setting. 

I think I’ll go back to SC with DEC turned back on.
You go 20 above speed limit, you don’t worry about get a speeding ticket?
I am traveling 50 miles per hour on 45 speed limit. The guy keeps flashing me in the back
Drivers in New Jersey doesn’t respect speed limits sign
You will be pulled over if you drive over the speed limit too much on New York upstate. I see a lot of drivers pulled over and get a ticket

I try to keep my max speed at 20 above limit, but if you’re going 15-20 over (in the middle not right lane) and still getting passed by lots of cars… yeah.

And well aware of the NY State speed enforcement, try to avoid that.

Ballsy haha, guess it depends on the state though. 

I’ll do 5 over on city streets and 10 over on the highway, max
